London brief

Monday: sell a fake break of Friday's high, half size.

The dollar slid overnight towards a support area, and the pound is right under Friday's high with a sell gap just above. Mondays often fake one way before the real move, so we look to sell a run above Friday's high that fails, at half size.

In plain English

Friday's high is 1.31287. Many traders have buy orders and stops just above it, and there's a gap where sellers stepped in last week at 1.31332-1.31392.

If London pushes into that gap and a 5-minute candle closes back below 1.31332 while the dollar starts rising, we sell for a move back to 1.31172 and 1.31100. If the pound keeps climbing, we do nothing.

The trader's view

  • Synthetic DXY 103.629: under TDO 103.765 and its Asia low 103.702, heading for the 1h/4h bull FVG 103.567-103.580 above PDL 103.548.
  • EUR +0.05%, GBP +0.02% since 05:00: the pound is the weaker, so it's the one to sell.
  • Week direction not set: Monday is the manipulation day; the weekly rule waits for a tap of an HTF array and the move away.

ICT breakdown

  • Bias: none yet for the week; intraday Judas-up into premium, Grade C.
  • Model: run of PDH 1.31287 into the 15m/1h bear FVG 1.31332-1.31392, CISD back below 1.31332, DXY 5m close up (from its 1h/4h bull FVG).
  • DOL: Asia high 1.31172 (30m bull FVG 1.31166-1.31221), then TDO 1.31100.

12:00Review
London review

0 pips: the fake break came late and ran past our stop.

The pound never reached our zone between 07:00 and 08:05, so we stood down. At 08:30 it spiked to 1.31457, through our zone and our stop, then fell to 1.31073. Our cancel rule would have closed the plan, so no trade was missed. Lesson: on Mondays the fake move can come later and run further, so use the whole gap plus a buffer at smaller size.
